title: RLM Harnesses and Inference-Time Learning: An Observational Case Study
description: Independent, non-peer-reviewed practitioner report on Claake Code, persistent Python, an exploratory ARC-AGI-3 pilot, and 30-day personal usage statistics. Findings are descriptive and token savings are not measured. The study and original data use CC BY 4.0; scripts use MIT, as described in LICENCES.md.
